parsed.explanation: No traveller-facing trans offence, entry/document obstacle, facility ban, police targeting, or custody rule is documented; the restrictive medicalised LGR regime, marriage bar and failed bills to ban transition are mainly resident-facing climate signals, not visitor exposures. Against that, documented hostility is substantial: official homophobic rhetoric in 2024, recurring regressive LGR bills (one passing first reading, fate unknown), a 2022 lethal shooting at an LGBT bar with a regional commissioner reporting no progress and increased risk six months later, and a broadly hostile public climate with thin, gender-identity-weak recourse. One shooting does not prove a pattern or state targeting, and no working visitor remedy is documented. This is tier-3 societal/official hostility without tier-1 universal exposure: elevated, not high, risk.
